RESULT Handoff — final synthesis and submission-ready hypothesis.

# Headline result

PRIMARY (paper-level, original-paper deduplicated via id):
- Experimental Economics (project == ee): mean length = 28.0 pages (n = 18 unique original papers; median 27.5; range 16-45)
- Psychology broad (project in {ml1, ml3, rpp}): mean length = 11.07 pages (n = 123 unique original papers; median 9; range 1-31)

Experimental Economics originals are on average about 16.93 pages longer, roughly 2.53x the length of Psychology originals in this dataset.

Sensitivities (robustness checks, both confirm the headline):
- Narrow Psychology (only project == rpp, 97 papers): 11.22 pages -> conclusion unchanged.
- Broad Psychology at O/R-pair (row) level: 10.15 pages (909 rows) -> conclusion unchanged.

# Evidence

- length column: int64, 0 missing values, 0 values lost to pd.to_numeric(errors=coerce) coercion.
- Repository: /workspace has task.json plus two CSVs in /workspace/data/. Only the study CSV has a length column.
- Cohort: 927 O/R-pair rows to 141 distinct original papers (deduplicated by id).
- Discipline x project cross-check is perfectly aligned: every ee row is discipline == Economics; every ml1/ml3/rpp row is discipline in {Cognitive, Social}.
- Per-project means (paper-level): ee 28.00 (n=18), ml1 8.88 (n=16), ml3 13.10 (n=10), rpp 11.22 (n=97).

# Artifacts (under /workspace/artifacts/analysis/)

- analysis.py: executed analysis script (217 lines)
- analysis.ipynb: executed notebook with cell outputs (224 lines)
- group_summary.csv: group statistics with columns group, level, n_unique_papers, n_rows, mean_length, median_length, min_length, max_length
- headline.json: primary/sensitivity numeric results

# Limitations and transparently flagged assumptions

- Both CSV files were supplied; only the study CSV contains length, and the other CSV was excluded (noted in the workflow).
- Psychology is interpreted in the broad sense (ml1 plus ml3 plus rpp, 123 papers). The narrow reading (rpp only, 97 papers, 11.22 pages) is reported as a sensitivity and does not change the conclusion.
- Aggregation unit: unique original paper (id-deduplicated). Within each project, replication counts are uniform across papers (ee 1, ml1 37, ml3 22, rpp 1 per paper), so row-level and id-level means coincide inside each project. They diverge only when pooling broad Psychology (row-mean 10.15 vs id-mean 11.07), and this divergence is explicitly reported as a sensitivity.
- Length is taken at face value as pages (the column legend says so); no imputation was needed.
